$comment: Implementation registry for the rules constitution (#1006). The constitution itself is docs/rules/RULES_CONSTITUTION.md with data/rules/rules_constitution.json; this file answers a different question: which CWN/SWN/WWN/AWN layer is actually backed by code in this repository, and which NooPunk overlays exist. A layer may only claim a status it can evidence with a path that exists, and `implemented` additionally requires a test that exists. Checked by tests/test_overlay_registry_1006.py.

core.name: Cities Without Number
core.note: Two Python cores and one Godot core exist; the MUD package is parity-tested against src/rules. Consolidating them is tracked debt, not an invitation to change arithmetic.

modules.name: SWN psionics
modules.note: Required by the constitution and not yet implemented. The Noosphere overlay models exposure, not the SWN psionic disciplines themselves; do not present one as the other.

modules.name: SWN space travel, ships and faction turns
modules.note: Wormhole travel in NoöPunk needs a transit procedure; take SWN's rather than inventing one.

modules.name: AWN survival and stress
modules.note: Data and a Godot overlay exist; no MUD implementation yet.

modules.name: WWN additional material
modules.note: Imported only when a case needs it.

overlays.name: GUMSHOE-inspired investigation
overlays.note: Pools buy benefits; a core clue is never gated by a roll. SRD-cited, no commercial-game text.

overlays.name: Noösphere, ontological shock and PbtA moves
overlays.note: Exposure is narrative pressure, not an illness, and never overrides a CWN result.

overlays.name: Psyche states
overlays.note: The overlay reads state and returns it; it never rolls.

overlays.name: LaclauGPT-inspired ideology, factions and reputation
overlays.note: Faction state and reputation exist; signifier/articulation mechanics do not. A full faction simulation is later scope.

vanilla-cwn.description: Faithful CWN with no NoöPunk features. Must stay playable.

minimum-playable.description: CWN plus SWN psionics: the smallest build that supports the PSI premise.

full-noopunk.description: The intended experience: core, psionics, investigation, Noösphere, ideology.
